# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Quick pick:** For most people, get the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand**. If you want the fastest iPhone charging on a nightstand, get the **Nomad Stand One Max**.

## Top picks

**1. Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand: best overall (~$80–$98)**
- This is WIRED's top pick after testing more than 30 models.
- It's a chrome "tree" that holds your iPhone and Watch in the air, with an AirPods spot on the base.
- The iPhone pad tilts, and you can turn the phone sideways for StandBy (clock) mode.
- It charges the iPhone at 15 W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer.
- A 36 W power adapter is included, and the warranty is 2 years.
- WIRED found it for $80 at Best Buy, $90 at Amazon and $98 at Belkin.
- Shop links: [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**2. Nomad Stand One Max: fastest and most premium ($169)**
- It charges the iPhone at 25 W (Qi2 25W) and fast-charges the Apple Watch.
- It has a heavy, glossy black base that doesn't tip when you lift your phone off with one hand.
- It comes with a 6.6-ft braided cable.
- **No power adapter is included.** You'll need a 40 W one, such as Nomad's $25 adapter.
- Shop link: [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**3. ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station: best budget (~$40, down from $80)**
- WIRED calls it by far the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 they've found.
- It charges the iPhone at 15 W, has a compact design and supports StandBy.
- The charging brick and cable are included.
- The Watch charger detaches, so you can travel with it.
- Shop link: [WIRED's review (Amazon link)](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**4. ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 (25 W): 25 W on a budget ($99.99, or about $82 with a code)**
- It charges the iPhone at 25 W and has a cooling fan. The fan has an off button, which helps for quiet nights.
- It folds up, so it travels well.
- A 50 W adapter is included.
- A deal site says code **PARTNER18** took 18% off at ESR's own US store when they tested it on Oct 23. The code expires Dec 31.
- WIRED's caveats: the plastic doesn't feel premium, and 25 W makes little difference if you charge overnight.
- Shop link: [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission. You can also search ESR's store directly.

## Other good options

- **[Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html):** This is the tallest and most adjustable folding stand Macworld has tested. It works well as a desk stand and for travel, and it includes a 45 W adapter plus UK and EU plugs.
- **[Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/):** It's a flat pad, so screens stay out of sight while you sleep, and it charges at 25 W. Its Watch charging is slow.

## Is 25 W worth paying for?

- **Which iPhones get it:** Only the iPhone 17 series and iPhone 16 Pro Max/16 Plus charge at 25 W. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20 W, and older iPhones get 15 W.
- **Overnight charging:** WIRED says 25 W makes little real difference if you charge overnight.
- **My advice:** If you mainly charge at night, the cheaper 15 W Belkin or ESR is fine. Pay for 25 W only if you top up during the day.

Prices are from these reviews and may have changed, so check before buying.
